ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Mars at {H:1825502105000}

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.
